title: Researcher friend in touch with Eric Henry Wang's daughter

tellings.quote: I could say definitively he was real cuz I have a researcher friend who's in touch with his daughter now.

plain: A man named Eric Henry Wang, linked to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in the 1950s, really existed, says Jesse Michels, who tells this from what a researcher friend he does not name told him. Michels says "I could say definitively he was real cuz I have a researcher friend who's in touch with his daughter now," and he offers it to show that a figure from these old stories was a real person.
